confval-badwordlist.name: badWordList
confval-badwordlist.summary: Comma separated list of word, that validator badWordFilter will avoid

confval-badwordvalidator.name: BadWordValidator
confval-badwordvalidator.summary: Checks if the field contains non of the word in the list is present.

confval-istruevalidator.name: IsTrueValidator
confval-istruevalidator.summary: Checks if the field is set for example the general terms and conditions

confval-requiredvalidator.name: RequiredValidator
confval-requiredvalidator.summary: This validator serves two purpose. First of check if the field contains a value and that it is not empty. Second the rendering uses this validator as condition to render required sign or not.

confval-blockdomainvalidator.name: BlockDomainValidator
confval-blockdomainvalidator.summary: Check that the email field does not contain any of the words in the list for the domain.

confval-captchavalidator.name: CaptchaValidator
confval-captchavalidator.summary: Checks if the entered value matches the captcha text by using the same captcha adapter like the one used for the rendering. Therefor the option type needs to equal the configuration of the rendering.

confval-emptyvalidator.name: EmptyValidator
confval-emptyvalidator.summary: Checks if the field uid is empty to no unauthorized user manipulation could happen.

confval-equalcurrentpasswordvalidator.name: EqualCurrentPasswordValidator
confval-equalcurrentpasswordvalidator.summary: This validator is used in the password change process. It compares if the entered old password is equal to the current set password for the account the user is logged in with.

confval-equalcurrentuservalidator.name: EqualCurrentUserValidator
confval-equalcurrentuservalidator.summary: On edit process it's important that the correct user data get modified. To ensure that the submitted data does not temper the user id. This validator compares the user id send by the form with the user id of the logged in user to prevent and change of the id.

confval-imageuploadvalidator.name: ImageUploadValidator
confval-imageuploadvalidator.summary: The image upload validator checks if the file uploaded has an allowed file extension and if the file size is in the allowed max size. Both checks uses system configuration.

confval-uniquevalidator.name: UniqueValidator
confval-uniquevalidator.summary: Checks if the value is unique for the field in the storage folder. If the option 'global' is set a second check for the value in the field is done system wide.

confval-repeatvalidator.name: RepeatValidator
confval-repeatvalidator.summary: To ensure that the input of a user was done without mistake by the user self it's a good idea to have the values entered in two fields and then compare their values. That is possible with this validator.
